text: The 1295 follow-up clears the selection before removing the test account to avoid an I/O complaint. The accepted test now also waits for gMessage to be null, document loading to stop and the URI to become about:blank. For this test teardown, the later state checks are stronger than assigning selectedIndex = -1 alone. This is a limited current comparison; it does not establish the exact cause of the original complaint or a project-wide teardown rule. No cleanup test was executed. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.
title: Account-removal cleanup waits for a blank message pane in current tests
